news.full_article_text: Chris Van Hollen (L) says he will challenge Chuck Schumer (R) and that the Democrats need new leadership - Published 13 November 2026, 15:48 GMT Senator Chuck Schumer is facing a challenge to his position as US Senate majority leader from his fellow Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen, as the party prepares to take control of Congress after sweeping the midterm elections. Van Hollen, 67, said in a post on X on Thursday that Americans voted for change earlier this month and "to deliver, we need new leadership". Schumer, 75, has led Democrats in the chamber since 2017, serving as both majority and minority leader. He was first elected to the Senate in 1999. Following the midterms earlier this month, his position has come under pressure by some left-wing Democrats who see him as too moderate and part of the party establishment. Responding to the challenge, Schumer, who represents New York, said he welcomed "any discussion about the future of our caucus and the important work ahead". He added that he was "proud of what we've accomplished together" in the midterms, and he had "the votes to continue as Democratic leader". The vote on Senate leader will be held behind closed doors in early December and the winner will assume the role on 4 January, when Democrats take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives after their midterms successes. The move by Van Hollen, who represents Maryland, marks the most significant step by a high-profile Democrat to challenge the party's existing leadership following last week's midterms victory. Announcing his plans to run in a post on X, he wrote that Americans had called on the party to "unrig an economy rigged against working people". "We should not be preserving our institutions if they are not delivering for the American people," he said at a summit in Colorado hosted by majority Democrats. "And we should be making delivering for the American people the single mission of our government, even when that means shaking things up." He added: "This country does not belong to the people who can afford to buy influence. It belongs to all of us. And it's time we govern like that." In recent years, Van Hollen has taken positions popular with those on the left of his party. In 2024, he supported restricting weapons shipments to Israel and criticised the Biden administration over its role in the war in Gaza. In an interview with MS NOW, Van Hollen - who has served in the Senate for nearly a decade - acknowledged that he was an "underdog" but added that he believed the race was "very much in flux". Independent Senator Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have both publicly come out in support of Van Hollen - while others have also called for new leadership. In a post on X, Sanders said he believed Van Hollen "will stand up to powerful special interests, take on the billionaire class and fight for working families". El-Sayed said the challenger would bring "bold leadership" and lead with both "courage and experience". Others Democrats have publicly backed Schumer. Senator Jacky Rosen of Nevada said: "He has the experience and the fight to continue leading our diverse caucus at this crucial moment". Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said: "You will see, despite all the grumblings, enormous gratitude for the hard work he has done to get us to this position." news.headline: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
news.story_lead: The Pope, who has Peruvian citizenship, lived in Chiclayo for several years - Published 1 hour ago Pope Leo XIV has celebrated mass near the Peruvian city where he made his name as a compassionate bishop who worked closely with poor and migrant communities. The ceremony was held on Friday at a park in Pimentel, about 10km (six miles) from Chiclayo in northern Peru as part of his tour of Latin America. The Vatican estimates more than 1.5 million people gathered to welcome the pontiff.
news.full_article_text: The Pope, who has Peruvian citizenship, lived in Chiclayo for several years - Published 1 hour ago Pope Leo XIV has celebrated mass near the Peruvian city where he made his name as a compassionate bishop who worked closely with poor and migrant communities. The ceremony was held on Friday at a park in Pimentel, about 10km (six miles) from Chiclayo in northern Peru as part of his tour of Latin America. The Vatican estimates more than 1.5 million people gathered to welcome the pontiff. "Thank you for your affection, support and prayers," the Pope told followers. "Especially for my health during this time of trial which, with God's help, I am overcoming," he added, referencing the surgery he had for lung cancer which took place just weeks ago . Some of the crowd arrived 12 hours in advance to wait in vigil before the mass began. "We spent the night praying, alongside family, excited to welcome the Pope from Chiclayo," said Isa Orderique. Pope Leo celebrated mass in front of a jubilant crowd Many came from across Peru and even neighbouring countries to attend. Merli Cruz Guerrero, from an area near the Ecuadorean border, travelled several hours by bus to attend. She also spent the entire night waiting. Of all the events the Pope has attended so far during his visit to Peru, this felt particularly emotional. The crowd fell into a hushed silence as the pontiff's motorcade approached. They waited eagerly for his arrival despite spending long hours out in the open with the temperature pushing past 30C. For many living here, the fact that the Pope worked extensively in this region before becoming the head of the Catholic Church has put them in the spotlight. "The Pope has come home and Chiclayo is celebrating," said Lisbeth DÃ­az, a teacher who worked with Pope Leo when he served as the city's bishop between 2015 and 2023. Lisbet DÃ­az says Chiclayo is celebrating the Pope's return Peru is the longest stop on the first tour of Latin America by the pontiff , who was elected in May 2025. The trip has also taken in Argentina and Uruguay, but his time in this country carries particular significance. The Pope not only lived in Peru for long periods between 1985 and 2023 but also became a citizen of the country in 2015, forging close ties with local communities. Around Chiclayo, it is hard to meet anyone who doesn't claim to be a friend of the Pope or have a special anecdote about him. Some recall how he would enjoy sampling Peruvian delicacies at El TrÃ©bol, a restaurant next to the city's cathedral. Others remember his love of tennis. But for many it's the more serious moments of his time here, such as helping launch soup kitchens during the Covid-19 pandemic, or wading through deep waters on horseback when floods hit the area. Several of these images are on display in a small museum dedicated to him at the entrance to the bishop's residence. Commemorative pictures of the Pope are sold in the main of square of Chiclayo, including a famous image of him visiting a remote village on horseback But for the city, and for a country that calls him the "Peruvian Pope", his return home means much more than a collection of photographs and anecdotes. "It is the return of the man who brought Peruvians closer to the Church," said Samuel David Miranda Atoche, a local parish priest from Chiclayo who was ordained by the Pope back when he was still the bishop and known under his birth name of Robert Prevost. And it is not just local people he connected with, according to DÃ­az, who came to Chiclayo from Venezuela. "It was difficult for him to see so many migrants living on the streets," she added, recalling the time when large numbers of Venezuelans came through Chiclayo escaping the political and economic crisis in their home country. "So, he got in touch with the migration authorities and coordinated with other organisations to speed up the paperwork needed for many of us to obtain legal residency and work permits." - Who is Robert Prevost, the new Pope Leo XIV? Published 9 May 2025 Robert Prevost's time here as bishop also involved difficult decisions, such as having to deal with the controversy and scandal surrounding the dissolution of Sodalitium of Christian Life, a Peruvian Catholic organisation that had faced decades of sexual abuse allegations. Santiago Roncagliolo, a Peruvian writer and journalist who has studied the Pope's life, believes his handling of that crisis earned him the favour of his predecessor, Pope Francis, and helped set him on the path to the papacy. Father David also stressed the role the now-pontiff played in bringing people together. "If there is one thing Bishop Prevost worked for here," he added, referring to the Pope by his previous title, "it was unity". That unity has been on display in the run up to the mass, with the square in front of Chiclayo Cathedral filled with joyous celebrations for days. Father David says the Pope brought Peruvians closer to the Church Normally, 800,000 people live in the city and its surrounding area, but estimates say the Pope's visit has caused that to double. Local businesses have been capitalising on the Pope's popularity to boost sales and hotels have sharply increased their nightly room rates. But that didn't seem to put off the faithful who gathered for the mass. Shouts of: "The Pope is from Chiclayo!" echoed across the field during the event. Their affection was clearly reflected by the pontiff. "As I look at your faces, a prayer of thanksgiving to the Lord arises in my heart," he said from the stage, "for the blessing you have been and continue to be in my life." news.exam_corner_topic: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
news.headline: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
news.story_lead: Watch: What we know so far about the Microsoft outage - Published 13 November 2026, 07:12 GMT A major Microsoft outage has impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world. Services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot, are being restored almost 24 hours since issues first surfaced. Microsoft said the outage was not a cyber-security incident and was caused by a technical issue.
news.full_article_text: Watch: What we know so far about the Microsoft outage - Published 13 November 2026, 07:12 GMT A major Microsoft outage has impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world. Services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot, are being restored almost 24 hours since issues first surfaced. Microsoft said the outage was not a cyber-security incident and was caused by a technical issue. It has apologised for the disruption. Here's what we know about the services affected and what went wrong. - Schools, GPs and businesses hit by global Microsoft outage as company scrambles to solve issue What happened? Some Microsoft 365 services have been affected by "connectivity problems" with problems reported in at least 74 countries. From late on Thursday, customers reported varying levels of access - many were unable to send or receive emails, view certain files or details on their calendar apps. But some users were able to use Teams, messaging and online meeting functions without issues. As of Friday afternoon, Microsoft said it had seen "encouraging recovery progress" in Europe and improvement in North America. The company added that it was focused on "addressing the remaining areas of disruption" but warned "some users may still experience intermittent issues". In a later statement, the company said it was continuing to see improvements "with email queues significantly reduced and approaching normal levels". The company attributed the ongoing outage to an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade. "We have addressed the underlying issue and continue to restore service to remaining customers and regions," it said on Friday. Will emails affected by the outage ever arrive? Although services are beginning to resume, Microsoft has warned of continued "intermittent access issues", meaning some users will still struggle to load their inboxes and could experience "delayed email delivery". In other words, it is not quite safe to assume every email you send is going to arrive in its intended recipient's inbox right away. Earlier, Microsoft said it would be extending the "timeout window" to 48 hours "to help protect delayed messages as delivery catches up". The email timeout window refers to the amount of time Outlook will wait to receive an email. When they do show up, the timestamp will be when they were delivered rather than when they were sent. Why has it taken so long to fix? Although email service Outlook appears to be resuming, the outage has so far lasted for more than 20 hours - in outage terms that is considered a long time. Prof James Ferryman from the University of Reading's department of computer science said the details the company has disclosed provide some clues. "What Microsoft has told us is that the part of its servers that sets up secure connections is getting swamped, and once that happens the server just stops answering," he said. "The trouble is that this kind of failure snowballs. "One server falls over, its work gets passed to the next one, and meanwhile huge numbers of phones and laptops keep trying to get back in. "You can't just turn it all back on at once. You have to bring it back bit by bit." The challenge is therefore not just fixing the fault, but managing the huge surge of devices trying to reconnect once services start coming back online. Gergely Orosz, a former leading software engineer at several major tech companies including Skype and Uber, said this could be the "most disruptive" business email outage "of all time". He said it was still difficult to know just how many people have been affected by the disruption, but added he "cannot recall" an outage over business email ever taking this long to return to normal. Australian cyber-security expert Troy Hunt told the BBC the outage could have far-reaching consequences. "Microsoft is a massive part of the internet backbone and reminds us how critical email still is. "Not only does this outage affect many people's ability to work but also things like the ability to communicate about appointments, purchase things that need verification, create or access accounts and services," he said. In a statement, Microsoft said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously. We are seeing broad recovery and stability across our services." How many people have been affected? More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps according to Microsoft's website. The full scale of the outage has not been confirmed. Microsoft 365 is used by companies worldwide and is expected to have a knock-on effect to other services. Tech giants OpenAI and Anthropic both earlier reported problems as a result of the outage. ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it was investigating an issue affecting its connections to Microsoft's services, which had caused some tools to not work as expected. From city governments in the US to Australian spy agencies, disruption across the globe has been widespread. Courts from Los Angeles to Texas earlier warned that communications might be delayed. In Canada, the public broadcaster CBC reported that a healthcare network running several hospitals in Toronto was experiencing email issues, but that patient care was not affected. The government of Japan also said its shared IT platform had been disrupted. Across the UK, GP surgeries, pharmacies, police and schools have been affected by the outage. Some GP surgeries had urged patients not to submit messages via their website while police forces were also earlier asking the public to call if they want to make a report. "Not only does this outage affect many people's ability to work but also things like the ability to communicate about appointments, purchase things that need verification, create or access accounts and services," he said. In a statement, Microsoft said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously. We are seeing broad recovery and stability across our services." How many people have been affected? More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps according to Microsoft's website. The full scale of the outage has not been confirmed. Microsoft 365 is used by companies worldwide and is expected to have a knock-on effect to other services. Tech giants OpenAI and Anthropic both earlier reported problems as a result of the outage. ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it was investigating an issue affecting its connections to Microsoft's services, which had caused some tools to not work as expected. From city governments in the US to Australian spy agencies, disruption across the globe has been widespread. Courts from Los Angeles to Texas earlier warned that communications might be delayed. In Canada, the public broadcaster CBC reported that a healthcare network running several hospitals in Toronto was experiencing email issues, but that patient care was not affected. The government of Japan also said its shared IT platform had been disrupted. Across the UK, GP surgeries, pharmacies, police and schools have been affected by the outage. Some GP surgeries had urged patients not to submit messages via their website while police forces were also earlier asking the public to call if they want to make a report. news.headline: NHRC notice to education ministry over complaint related to 'Veer Baal Diwas' events in schools
news.story_lead: NHRC notice to education ministry over complaint related to 'Veer Baal Diwas' events in schools New Delhi, The NHRC has issued a notice to the education ministry over a complaint alleging that adequate awareness and educational activities concerning the Veer Baal Diwas on December 26 have not received "commensurate attention". The complaint notes the celebrations organised across schools on November 14 Jawaharlal Nehru's birthday, which is celebrated as Children's Day. According to the proceedings of the case, a bench of the National Human Rights Commission , presided over by its member Priyank Kanoongo, has sought a comprehensive action taken report within two weeks from the date of receipt of the notice.
news.full_article_text: NHRC notice to education ministry over complaint related to 'Veer Baal Diwas' events in schools New Delhi, The NHRC has issued a notice to the education ministry over a complaint alleging that adequate awareness and educational activities concerning the Veer Baal Diwas on December 26 have not received "commensurate attention". The complaint notes the celebrations organised across schools on November 14 Jawaharlal Nehru's birthday, which is celebrated as Children's Day. According to the proceedings of the case, a bench of the National Human Rights Commission , presided over by its member Priyank Kanoongo, has sought a comprehensive action taken report within two weeks from the date of receipt of the notice. The NHRC proceedings are dated November 13. The present complaint has been lodged by Sanjeev Newar of Sewa Nyaya Utthan Foundation, bringing to the attention of the commission "concerns regarding the awareness and observance of Veer Bal Diwas, officially recognised by the government of India and observed on December 26 every year in commemoration of the supreme sacrifice of the Sahibzadas of Guru Gobind Singh Ji," it says. The complainant has alleged that while schools across the country organise celebrations on November 14 as Children's Day, "adequate awareness and educational activities concerning Veer Bal Diwas and the extraordinary courage, sacrifice and historical significance associated with the Sahibzadas have not received commensurate attention," it says. The complaint emphasises the importance of ensuring that children are "meaningfully sensitised" about the supreme sacrifices of the Sahibzadas, the historical circumstances in which they displayed extraordinary courage, and the values of bravery and the sacrifices made, according to the proceedings. The commission is of the view that educational institutions play an important role in developing historical awareness, constitutional values and a sense of national heritage among children. It is, therefore, important that appropriate institutional initiatives are undertaken to familiarise students with the significance of Veer Baal Diwas and the sacrifices it commemorates, it says. The commission is, therefore, satisfied that the issues raised in the complaint "warrant examination and intervention" under Section 12 of the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993, as per the proceedings. The registry was also directed to issue notice to the secretary, department of school education and literacy in the Ministry of Education, asking it to submit an action taken report. This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text. - Ministry Of Education

news.exam_corner_topic: Yes Bank Supreme Court Petition on AT-1 Bonds
static_gk: Yes Bank: Private sector bank in India, established in 2004, headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
AT-1 Bonds (Additional Tier-1 Bonds): Perpetual debt instruments without a maturity date, issued by commercial banks to meet core Tier-1 capital requirements under Basel III norms.
Article 137 of the Indian Constitution: Grants the Supreme Court of India the power to review any judgment pronounced or order made by it.
news.headline: Yes Bank Files Review Petition in Supreme Court Over AT-1 Bond Verdict
news.story_lead: Indian private sector lender Yes Bank has submitted a review petition to the Supreme Court of India regarding its verdict on Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) bonds. The petition seeks a judicial re-examination of rulings concerning the writing off or restructuring of these perpetual debt instruments.
news.full_article_text:
### Judicial Review Initiated by Yes Bank

Private sector lender Yes Bank has moved the Supreme Court of India, filing a formal review petition against an existing judicial order regarding its Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) bonds.

### Key Factual Highlights
* **Filing Body:** Yes Bank Limited.
* **Jurisdiction:** Supreme Court of India.
* **Core Matter:** Review petition challenging the apex court's directives on the write-off and legal status of AT-1 bonds.
* **Financial Instrument:** Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) bonds, which are unsecured, perpetual capital instruments utilized by commercial banks under Basel III capital adequacy guidelines.

The judicial outcome of this review petition is watched closely by market participants, as AT-1 bond rulings hold major implications for capital-raising norms, bank recapitalization procedures, and debt market stability in the Indian financial sector.
bullet_points: Yes Bank has filed a review petition in the Supreme Court of India regarding an order on AT-1 bonds.
The petition requests a judicial re-evaluation of directives related to the writing off or treatment of the bank's perpetual capital instruments.
AT-1 bonds are subordinated, perpetual, non-cumulative debt obligations used by commercial banks to fulfill core capital standards under Basel III rules.
The case has significant implications for corporate debt markets, investor protection, and banking recapitalization in India.

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### यस बैंक द्वारा न्यायिक पुनर्विचार की पहल

निजी क्षेत्र के ऋणदाता यस बैंक ने अपने अतिरिक्त टियर-1 (AT-1) बॉन्ड से संबंधित एक मौजूदा न्यायिक आदेश के खिलाफ भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का रुख करते हुए एक औपचारिक पुनर्विचार याचिका दायर की है।

### प्रमुख मुख्य बिंदु
* **याचिकाकर्ता:** यस बैंक लिमिटेड।
* **क्षेत्राधिकार:** भारत का सर्वोच्च न्यायालय।
* **मुख्य विषय:** यस बैंक द्वारा जारी किए गए AT-1 बॉन्ड के राइट-ऑफ और कानूनी स्थिति पर शीर्ष अदालत के निर्देशों की पुनर्प्रासंगिकता का विश्लेषण।
* **वित्तीय साधन:** अतिरिक्त टियर-1 (AT-1) बॉन्ड, जो बासेल III पूंजी पर्याप्तता दिशानिर्देशों के तहत वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले असुरक्षित, शाश्वत पूंजी साधन हैं।

इस पुनर्विचार याचिका के न्यायिक परिणाम पर बाजार प्रतिभागी करीब से नजर रख रहे हैं, क्योंकि AT-1 बॉन्ड के फैसले भारत के वित्तीय क्षेत्र में पूंजी जुटाने के नियमों और ऋण बाजार की स्थिरता पर महत्वपूर्ण प्रभाव डालते हैं।
bullet_points: यस बैंक ने AT-1 बॉन्ड पर एक आदेश के संबंध में भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में पुनर्विचार याचिका दायर की है।
याचिका में बैंक के शाश्वत पूंजी साधनों को राइट ऑफ करने या उनके उपचार से जुड़े निर्देशों के न्यायिक पुनर्मूल्यांकन का अनुरोध किया गया है।
AT-1 बॉन्ड बासेल III नियमों के तहत वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा मुख्य पूंजी मानकों को पूरा करने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले अधीनस्थ, शाश्वत ऋण दायित्व हैं।
इस मामले के भारत में कॉर्पोरेट ऋण बाजारों, निवेशक संरक्षण और बैंकिंग पुनर्गठन पर दूरगामी प्रभाव हैं।
सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में पुनर्विचार कार्यवाही संविधान के अनुच्छेद 137 के तहत शासित होती है।

AT-1 बॉन्ड में नियामक शर्तों के तहत राइट-डाउन का विकल्प शामिल होता है।

news.headline: Cabinet Rift Erupts in US Over Nvidia AI Chip Export Control Failures and National Security Risks
news.story_lead: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has publicly criticized Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over delays in restricting exports of advanced Nvidia artificial intelligence chips to China. The rift follows the ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over an affair with an executive linked to Megaspeed, a firm suspected of illicitly channeling high-end microchips into China.
news.full_article_text:
### Overview of the Controversy
Public friction within US President Donald Trump's cabinet has intensified following security concerns surrounding Nvidia's export of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) semiconductors. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly blamed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's department for failing to promptly place cloud computing firm Megaspeed on the official trade entity control list despite warnings from multiple government agencies.

### Leadership Ouster and Espionage Allegations
The fallout was triggered by the ouster of Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following revelations of an unapproved relationship with a businesswoman associated with Megaspeed. US intelligence agencies suspect the executive of ties to Chinese espionage operations aimed at bypassing trade restrictions to acquire critical AI infrastructure.

### Key Export Rules and Regulatory Failures
- **Export Policy Mandate:** President Donald Trump issued explicit directives prohibiting China from acquiring any Nvidia AI processors exceeding the performance capabilities of the H100 microchip.
- **Route and Tariff Loophole:** Under current policy mechanisms, Nvidia's higher-capacity H200 chips manufactured in Taiwan were permitted for export after being imported into the US for physical inspection and subjected to a 25% tariff under national security trade statutes.
- **Entity List Delays:** Although multiple federal intelligence and financial security agencies advocated placing Megaspeed on the US Entity List for months, administrative delays within the Department of Commerce prevented formal blacklisting.

### Congressional Inquiries and Legal Actions
1. **Senate Banking Committee Hearing:** Committee Chairman Tim Scott (Republican) summoned both Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify regarding security lapses in December 2026.
2. **Records Retention Demands:** Democrats on key congressional panels, led by House Ways and Means Committee Ranking Member Richard E. Neal and Senate Finance Committee Ranking Member Ron Wyden, demanded full retention of all administrative records and internal communications regarding Nvidia sales approvals.
3. **Investigation into Trade Enforcement:** Lawmakers highlighted that national security trade provisions intended to protect domestic technology were improperly utilized, allowing sensitive H200 processors to reach foreign end-users.
news.background_context: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick previously competed for the Treasury Secretary position in 2024 ahead of Trump's return to the presidency and have clashed over federal tariff policies.

hindi_translation.headline: अमेरिका में एनवीडिया एआई चिप निर्यात नियंत्रण विफलता और राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा चिंताओं पर कैबिनेट में विवाद गहराया
hindi_translation.story_lead: अमेरिकी वित्त मंत्री स्कॉट बेसेंट ने वाणिज्य मंत्री हावर्ड लुटनिक के विभाग पर चीन को उन्नत एनवीडिया आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस चिप्स के निर्यात को रोकने में ढिलाई का सार्वजनिक रूप से आरोप लगाया है। यह विवाद एनवीडिया के सीईओ जेन्सेन हुआंग को मेघास्पीड से जुड़ी एक महिला कार्यकारी के साथ संबंधों के उजागर होने के बाद पद से हटाए जाने के बाद सामने आया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### विवाद का अवलोकन
अमेरिका के राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प के मंत्रिमंडल के भीतर एनवीडिया के उन्नत आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) सेमीकंडक्टरों के निर्यात को लेकर राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा चिंताओं के कारण आंतरिक मतभेद सार्वजनिक हो गए हैं। वित्त मंत्री स्कॉट बेसेंट ने कई एजेंसियों की सिफारिशों के बावजूद क्लाउड कंप्यूटिंग फर्म 'मेघास्पीड' को ब्लैकलिस्ट में डालने में देरी के लिए वाणिज्य मंत्री हावर्ड लुटनिक के विभाग को जिम्मेदार ठहराया।

### नेतृत्व में बदलाव और जासूसी के आरोप
यह विवाद एनवीडिया के मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी (CEO) जेन्सेन हुआंग को पद से हटाए जाने के बाद शुरू हुआ। हुआंग का मेघास्पीड से जुड़ी एक महिला कार्यकारी के साथ अनधिकृत संबंध सामने आया था। अमेरिकी खुफिया एजेंसियों को संदेह है कि वह कार्यकारी चीनी जासूसी अभियानों से जुड़ी थी, जिसका उद्देश्य व्यापार प्रतिबंधों को दरकिनार कर एआई चिप्स हासिल करना था।

### प्रमुख निर्यात नियम और नियामक खामियां
- **निर्यात नीति निर्देश:** राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने स्पष्ट निर्देश दिए थे कि चीन को H100 चिप्स से अधिक क्षमता वाले एनवीडिया एआई प्रोसेसर नहीं मिलने चाहिए।
- **मार्ग और टैरिफ की खामी:** मौजूदा व्यवस्था के तहत, ताइवान में निर्मित एनवीडिया की अधिक उन्नत H200 चिप्स को अमेरिका में निरीक्षण के लिए लाया जाता था और 25% शुल्क लगाकर निर्यात की अनुमति दी जाती थी।
- **एंटिटी लिस्ट में देरी:** यद्यपि कई सुरक्षा और वित्तीय एजेंसियों ने मेघास्पीड को एंटिटी लिस्ट में डालने का समर्थन किया था, लेकिन वाणिज्य विभाग की आंतरिक देरी के कारण आधिकारिक प्रतिबंध नहीं लगाया जा सका।

### संसदीय जांच और कानूनी कार्रवाई

hindi_translation.headline: पेटीएम को वॉलेट लाइसेंस के लिए आरबीआई की प्रारंभिक मंजूरी मिली; शेयर रिकॉर्ड स्तर पर पहुंचे
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारतीय फिनटेक कंपनी पेटीएम को वॉलेट लाइसेंस के लिए भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) से प्रारंभिक मंजूरी मिल गई है। इस नियामक मंजूरी की खबर के बाद कंपनी के शेयरों में जोरदार उछाल आया और वे रिकॉर्ड स्तर पर पहुंच गए।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### नियामक मंजूरी और बाजार पर प्रभाव
- **प्रारंभिक मंजूरी**: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) ने पेटीएम को उसके वॉलेट लाइसेंस आवेदन के लिए प्रारंभिक (इन-प्रिंसिपल) मंजूरी दे दी है, जो फिनटेक कंपनी के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण नियामक उपलब्धि है।
- **शेयर बाजार का प्रदर्शन**: केंद्रीय बैंक की प्रारंभिक मंजूरी की खबर सार्वजनिक होने के बाद, पेटीएम के शेयरों में भारी उछाल दर्ज किया गया और वे अपने अब तक के उच्चतम स्तर पर पहुंच गए।

### परिचालन और नीतिगत संदर्भ
- **लाइसेंसिंग ढांचा**: यह प्रारंभिक मंजूरी पेटीएम को आरबीआई के प्रीपेड पेमेंट इंस्ट्रूमेंट्स (PPI) दिशानिर्देशों के तहत डिजिटल वॉलेट परिचालन के लिए पूर्ण नियामक मंजूरी प्राप्त करने की दिशा में आगे बढ़ने का अवसर प्रदान करती है।
- **बाजार की धारणा**: कंपनी के अनुपालन पथ और नियामक स्पष्टता के कारण निवेशकों के विश्वास में सकारात्मक वृद्धि देखी गई है।

news.headline: TDB-DST Signs ₹64.05 Crore Pact with Astrome for AI-ELINT Satellites
news.story_lead: The Technology Development Board (TDB) under the Department of Science and Technology (DST) has entered into a financial agreement worth ₹64.05 crore with deep-tech company Astrome. The pact aims to accelerate the indigenous development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence-enabled Electronic Intelligence (AI-ELINT) satellite technologies.
news.full_article_text:
### Financial Agreement for Strategic Space Technology

The Technology Development Board (TDB), a statutory body under the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Science and Technology, signed a ₹64.05 crore pact with space-tech startup Astrome. The funding agreement is structured to support commercialization and technical scaling of advanced satellite systems in India.

### Key Focus: AI-ELINT Satellites

- **Core Technology:** The initiative centers on developing Artificial Intelligence-driven Electronic Intelligence (AI-ELINT) satellite payloads.
- **Capabilities:** ELINT systems intercept, analyze, and process electronic signals and non-communication transmissions. Integrating AI on-board allows real-time automated data processing and threat identification in space.
- **Public-Private Collaboration:** The project represents an institutional partnership between a government funding body (TDB-DST) and a private deep-tech space enterprise (Astrome).

### Strategic Importance

Developing indigenous AI-ELINT space capabilities strengthens national security and spatial situational awareness. By processing electronic intelligence at the satellite level, decision-making cycles can be dramatically reduced, supporting both defense surveillance and strategic communication monitoring.

hindi_translation.story_lead: विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग (DST) के तहत संचालित प्रौद्योगिकी विकास बोर्ड (TDB) ने स्पेस-टेक कंपनी एस्ट्रोम (Astrome) के साथ ₹64.05 करोड़ का वित्तीय समझौता किया है। इस समझौते का उद्देश्य कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता-संचालित इलेक्ट्रॉनिक इंटेलिजेंस (AI-ELINT) उपग्रह प्रौद्योगिकियों के स्वदेशी विकास को गति देना है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### रणनीतिक अंतरिक्ष प्रौद्योगिकी के लिए वित्तीय समझौता

विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग (DST) के एक सांविधिक निकाय, प्रौद्योगिकी विकास बोर्ड (TDB) ने स्पेस-टेक स्टार्टअप एस्ट्रोम के साथ ₹64.05 करोड़ के समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं। इस फंडिंग समझौते को भारत में उन्नत उपग्रह प्रणालियों के व्यावसायीकरण और तकनीकी विकास को समर्थन देने के लिए तैयार किया गया है।

### मुख्य फोकस: AI-ELINT उपग्रह

- **मूल प्रौद्योगिकी:** यह पहल आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस-संचालित इलेक्ट्रॉनिक इंटेलिजेंस (AI-ELINT) उपग्रह पेलोड विकसित करने पर केंद्रित है।
- **क्षमताएं:** ELINT प्रणालियां इलेक्ट्रॉनिक संकेतों और गैर-संचार प्रसारणों को इंटरसेप्ट, विश्लेषण और संसाधित करती हैं। पेलोड पर ही AI को एकीकृत करने से वास्तविक समय में स्वचालित डेटा प्रसंस्करण और खतरों की पहचान संभव हो जाती है।
- **सार्वजनिक-निजी सहयोग:** यह परियोजना एक सरकारी फंडिंग निकाय (TDB-DST) और एक निजी डीप-टेक स्पेस उद्यम (Astrome) के बीच एक संस्थागत साझेदारी का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है।

### रणनीतिक महत्व

स्वदेशी AI-ELINT अंतरिक्ष क्षमताओं को विकसित करने से राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा और अंतरिक्ष स्थितिजन्य जागरूकता मजबूत होती है। उपग्रह स्तर पर ही इलेक्ट्रॉनिक इंटेलिजेंस को संसाधित करने से निर्णय लेने के चक्र में भारी कमी आती है।
bullet_points: प्रौद्योगिकी विकास बोर्ड (TDB-DST) ने एस्ट्रोम के साथ ₹64.05 करोड़ के समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए।
इस समझौते का मुख्य उद्देश्य AI-ELINT (कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता - इलेक्ट्रॉनिक इंटेलिजेंस) उपग्रहों का स्वदेशी विकास करना है।
ELINT तकनीक उपग्रह आधारित इलेक्ट्रॉनिक संकेतों के इंटरसेप्शन और विश्लेषण से संबंधित है।
आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस का एकीकरण सीधे उपग्रह पेलोड पर डेटा के रियल-टाइम प्रोसेसिंग की सुविधा प्रदान करता है।
यह पहल डीप-टेक स्पेस नवाचार और निजी क्षेत्र की भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देने के राष्ट्रीय प्रयासों के अनुरूप है।
